Ava (docs): Drafted a short connectivity checklist for the private/VPC install guide that covers resolver checks, KMS endpoint verification, and an HSM management port sanity test. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1299
Rohan (eng-runtime): Nice. Can we include both UDP/TCP dig checks and an openssl example to confirm TLS handshake to the KMS? Also add an explicit placeholder for the resolver IP (use <resolver-ip>).
Ava (docs): Adding those. Current snippet (will be copy-paste friendly, no inline comments in the code block):
```
# DNS resolver checks (UDP & TCP)
dig @<resolver-ip> +short api.internal.redwood.example A
dig @<resolver-ip> +tcp +short api.internal.redwood.example A
# IPv6 probe (if applicable)
dig @<resolver-ip> +short api.internal.redwood.example AAAA
# KMS HTTPS health check (force host resolution)
curl -I --resolve "<kms-fqdn>:443:<kms-ip>" https://<kms-fqdn>/health
# HSM management port handshake (example port, adjust per customer)
openssl s_client -connect <hsm-mgmt-ip>:12345 -servername <hsm-hostname> -showcerts </dev/null
```
Priya (security): Please ensure we call out that the examples must use placeholder tokens (<kms-ip>, <hsm-mgmt-ip>, etc.) and not customer hostnames. Also add a short line about supplying the CA bundle in air-gapped installs: `curl --cacert /path/to/ca.pem ...`
Marco (installer): For sealed-site customers it helps to show the minimal /etc/hosts line and mention that some environments block outbound UDP/53 (recommend TCP fallback). Maybe a tiny nftables/iptables caveat: nat SNAT may alter source IP and break HSM admin rules.
Ava (docs): Incorporated: moved example host mappings into prose, added the `--cacert` example and a brief note on NAT/source IP for HSM ACLs. Also added a troubleshooting mini-table with two common failure messages and remedies: "connection refused" -> port not open; "TLS handshake failed" -> missing CA or SNI mismatch.
Rohan (eng-runtime): Could we add a one-liner that uses `nc -vz <hsm-mgmt-ip> 12345` as a low-dep TCP probe? Some customers don't have openssl handy.
Ava (docs): Done. Added `nc -vz <hsm-mgmt-ip> 12345` below the openssl line.
docs-deploy-bot: docs staging build succeeded (2026-03-23-0300) :white_check_mark:
Priya (security): LGTM, just a tiny wording nit: change "CA bundle" to "customer CA bundle" in the air-gapped section.
Ava (docs): Updated wording. Also ran doc-lint; fixed anchor links and replaced inline example IPs with placeholders.
Marco (installer): I'll open an issue on the installer repo to add a smoke check that runs the curl healthcheck and an nc probe as part of the basic postinstall test suite. Tracker: https://github.com/redwood-inference/installer/issues/502
Ava (docs): Thanks everyone 1: I will mark PR ready for review and ping devex for a quick copy edit. Closing once merged.
